    NativeJavahMojo - Class in org.codehaus.mojo.natives.plugin
    Deprecated.
    The javah tool was removed in Java 10, so this goal fails on Java 10 and later. Let the maven-compiler-plugin write the header files instead: set its headerOutputDirectory parameter (the -h option of javac, available since Java 8). This goal is removed in the next major version.
